LEFT: ONE real adult Emirati man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, bold emerald-green eyeliner with a sheer burgundy-stained lip, smooth warm golden-tan skin, a gentle soft smile, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a bronze ship's anchor, a silver pyramid-shaped lump, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a tin small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten platinum rings. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body. Powerful and imposing, yet lean and polished. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a black tricorn pirate hat with a white skull emblem, a red bandana knotted at his neck, black leather wrist cuffs with gold studs, and a minimal mirror-polished metallic black leather with mirror-polished metallic gold buckles T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material reflecting the flash in sharp specular glints, the hard light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
